description:
Patient Walter Bishop is being transferred to another facility. You need to compile a text summary of his ACTIVE medications and KNOWN allergies.

1. Search for patient 'Walter Bishop' (P_WB001).
2. Navigate to his Medications section.
3. Identify ONLY the medications with status 'Active'. Ignore any discontinued or completed medications.
4. Navigate to his Allergies/Medical History section to find his allergies.
5. Create a text file at '/home/ga/transfer_summary.txt' listing the active medications and allergies found.

The file should contain the names of the meds and allergies.
